# QnALog 1.5.2

QnALog makes its live-minutes entry easier to identify.

## Changes

- Replace the generic outline icon on the left ribbon with an original Q-shaped QnALog icon. The live-minutes view tab uses the same icon.
- Keep the existing ribbon position, tooltip, open-view action, and microphone recording shortcut.

## User impact

- No settings schema, API key storage, provider configuration, or device-selection changes; no reconfiguration is required.
- Existing notes and workspace layout are not rewritten.
- No user-facing features were removed.
